tei:div.tei:p: 477) dag snang las: sku phreng gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbyig thob bzhugs so: e ma ho: gdod nas dag pa gnyis ldan 'od gsal dbyings: lhun grub phra ba ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi rnal 'byor ma: gdul bya'i mos ngor chu zla'i gar sgyur ba: sna tshogs kun ston mdzad la gsol ba 'debs: rdzu 'phrul mnga' brnyes dge slong utpal ma: rlung bcur dbang thob ro langs dmar mo dang: phag mo mngon gyur rdo rje zhi ba mtsho: dwangs ma'i skur smin byang chub chos kyi sgron: rtogs pa phul phyin dī pam tā re maḥ rlung sems dbang thob ḍākki kun dga' 'bum: gnas lugs don gzigs mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgron: don gnyis mthar mdzad rta mgrin dbang mo dang: snyan brgyud bka' bab su kha badzra sogs: sku phreng rim par brgyud la gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi bar gsum 'bral med rjes bzung nas: khregs chod lha sgom spyod 'bras dbyer med don: gang shar ma bcos rig dbyings mngon gyur nas: gdod ma gzhi yi gnas lugs rtogs par shog: bzhugs stangs gsum dang gzigs stangs rnam gsum 478)gyis: gcun te sgo yul rlung rig la brten te: thod rgal snang bzhi'i nyams len mthar phyin te: 'ja' lus gzhon nu bum skur grol bar shog: bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i sems can kun: tshe 'dir 'chi ba'i lam la mi ltos par: rang snang don gyi 'og min zhing khams su: ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med sangs rgyas shog: ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge btsun dharma pa sham gyis 'di ltar dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngo mi ldog tsam du snyoms las pa kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mos 'phrul snang yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
